area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors

fields.description: Company country. A country with no row has no clearance and no B2B buyer tax ID rule.
fields.label: Country

fields.description: The regime's name, printed on the receipt. Other screens just say "clearance regime".
fields.label: Regime Label

fields.description: Holds each receipt until the fiscal app records the sale cleared or reported. The POS never calls the tax authority. Live at once.
fields.label: Clearance Required

fields.description: A full tax invoice to a business buyer needs their tax registration, taken at payment.
fields.label: Require Buyer Tax ID On Account

fields.description: Lets goods leave once paid while the sale clears. Unticked: goods wait until it clears.
fields.label: Release Goods Before Cleared

fields.description: Where clearance applies. Ticked: a deposit waits for a tax receipt number like a sale. Unticked: not fiscal.
fields.label: Deposit Is a Fiscal Event

fields.description: Lets tills sell offline in this clearance regime and report later. Blocked by default. Tick only on legal or compliance advice.
fields.label: Allow Offline Capture

lede: A country's fiscal settings for the fiscal reader.
name: Retail Fiscal Regime Config
